title: Decaf Latte with Non-Dairy Milk, Flavored

content.title: About
content.content: Decaf latte is a coffee‑based drink in which the caffeine has been removed, combined with a generous amount of frothed non‑dairy milk (soy, oat, almond, etc.) and flavorings such as vanilla, caramel, or nut extracts. It retains the creamy character of a classic latte while containing virtually no caffeine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water, carbon‑dioxide or solvent methods, preserving most of the coffee’s flavor compounds.
Plant‑based milks contain less saturated fat than cow’s milk and are suitable for vegans.
Flavored versions often use natural extracts, though some may contain artificial flavorings.
Decaf latte is popular among caffeine‑sensitive individuals, pregnant women, and children.
In several countries decaffeinated coffee is classified as a separate product category with its own regulations.

items.title: Reduced nervous system stimulation
items.content: The lack of caffeine lowers the risk of anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heart rate.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Decaf coffee retains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Gentler on the stomach
items.content: Without caffeine, the drink is less likely to irritate the gastric lining.

items.title: Low sugar content (when unsweetened)
items.content: If no sweetener is added, the beverage contains virtually no sugar, supporting blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from plant milk
items.content: Soy and oat milks are often fortified with calcium, vitamin D, and B12.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Soy, almond, or oat milks can trigger allergic reactions in susceptible individuals.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some flavorings may contain artificial sweeteners or preservatives that not everyone tolerates.

items.title: Possible flavor loss during decaffeination
items.content: The decaffeination process can diminish the intensity of coffee flavor compared with regular latte.

content.title: How to Enjoy
content.content: Serve hot or iced, optionally adding a sweetener, a sprinkle of cinnamon, or cocoa powder. It can also be used as a base for dessert cocktails, smoothies, or incorporated into baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated and consume within 24 hours. Store dry ingredients (coffee granules, flavorings) in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place.
